title: Pan-Fried Bao with Ukrainian Butter
description: A delicious Chinese-inspired dish featuring soft bao buns filled with a rich Ukrainian butter and pan-fried to perfection.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
Dust the bao buns with a pinch of flour to prevent sticking.
Add the softened Ukrainian butter to a small bowl and microwave for 10-15 seconds or until melted.
Brush the bao buns with the melted butter, making sure to get both sides.
Place the bao buns on the preheated pan and cook for 2-3 minutes on the first side or until golden brown.
Flip the bao buns and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the other side is also golden brown.
Serve the pan-fried bao buns warm, garnished with salt to taste.
